title: OKX launches EU stablecoin payment card via regulated issuer Monavate
summary: OKX says the card supports USDC and USDG spending, is issued via Monavate on Mastercard’s network and is available to verified EU users.

title: Crypto launderers are turning away from centralized exchanges: Chainalysis
summary: Chainalysis says the on-chain money laundering ecosystem processed $82 billion in funds in 2025, with Chinese-language networks now dominating.

title: A Fed move to backstop Japan bonds could boost Bitcoin: Arthur Hayes
summary: BitMEX founder Arthur Hayes says the yen is weakening while Japanese government bond yields are rising, which could lead to Japanese investors selling US Treasuries.

title: UK bans Coinbase ads that ‘trivialized’ crypto risks: Report
summary: Coinbase’s musical ad depicting a run-down UK, which was already blacklisted from TV, has reportedly seen a wider ban by the country’s ad watchdog for being “irresponsible.”

title: Coinbase moves closer toward rolling out ‘custom stablecoins’
summary: Coinbase is testing Flipcash’s USDF as part of a new feature that would let businesses issue branded, dollar-backed stablecoins.

title: Silver, gold hype overtaking crypto on social media: Santiment
summary: Silver prices have been on the rise and hit a new all-time high of just over $117 on Tuesday, though some analysts warn that a price top for the precious metal could be coming soon.

title: Trustless AI agent standard could hit Ethereum mainnet on Thursday
summary: ERC-8004, which a lead developer has tipped will be deployed to mainnet this week, enables AI agents to discover and trust each other across platforms without centralized gatekeepers.

title: Steak ‘n Shake adds $5M in Bitcoin to reserve as in-store sales grow 18%
summary: The restaurant chain said that its adoption of Bitcoin is one of the main reasons that it is “trouncing” its fast-food competitors.

title: Nearly 40% of US merchants now accept crypto at checkout: PayPal
summary: Adoption has been strongest in the hospitality, travel, digital goods, and gaming industries. Millennials and Gen Zs are proving to be the most crypto-savvy shoppers.

title: Rodeo becomes 2nd NFT platform to announce closure this week
summary: NFT marketplace Nifty Gateway announced on Saturday that it was shutting down, and has now been followed by Rodeo, which only launched on iOS last March.
